en.pitch: MapLibre style taste for coding agents: 6 named tastes, 15 check rules, and a loop that turns rainbow buildings into cinematic sequential blues.
en.forAgents: Install `maptaste-global` or `maptaste-cn` from the repo skills. Run `maptaste check` (v0.0.2, 15 rules + `hsl()`), revise from JSON findings with rule IDs and a 0–100 score. MCP tools: `check_taste`, `validate_style`, `preview_info`.

zh.pitch: 给写地图样式的 Agent 用的 MapLibre 品味检查：6 套命名风格、15 条检查规则，把彩虹建筑变成电影感顺序蓝。
zh.forAgents: 从仓库 skills 安装 `maptaste-global` 或 `maptaste-cn`。跑 `maptaste check`（v0.0.2，15 条规则 + `hsl()`），根据带规则 ID 和 0–100 分的 JSON 结果改。MCP 工具：`check_taste`、`validate_style`、`preview_info`。

en.pitch: Turns 9 mind-map formats — Yuque Lakeboard, XMind, XMind 8, OPML, FreeMind, MindManager, iThoughts, SimpleMind, and CSV — into Markdown, so ideas stop being trapped in a picture.
en.forAgents: Four MCP tools — `convert`, `convert_many`, and `inspect` are read-only, while `from_markdown` writes `.xmind` — returning typed structured output (sheets, node counts, a truncation flag) instead of a wall of text. Listed on Glama. npm 0.6.0.

zh.pitch: 把 9 种思维导图格式（语雀 Lakeboard、XMind、XMind 8、OPML、FreeMind、MindManager、iThoughts、SimpleMind、CSV）转成 Markdown，想法不用再锁在一张图里。
zh.forAgents: 四个 MCP 工具：`convert`、`convert_many`、`inspect` 为只读，`from_markdown` 写出 `.xmind`，返回带类型的结构化结果（画布、节点数、是否截断），不是一大坨文本。已经上了 Glama。npm 0.6.0。

en.pitch: Dashboard taste as a skill + check loop: 6 named tastes and 38 rules to shape ECharts dashboards, check the result, and revise.
en.forAgents: Install `dashtaste-global` or `dashtaste-cn` with `npx skills add FelixFangX/dashtaste`. Pick from 6 named tastes, run the 38-rule check (v0.0.8), and revise from JSON findings with rule IDs, fixes, and a 0–100 score. Carry local rules in `--pack-file` overlays; use `docs/cases` to narrate gallery changes.

zh.pitch: 把仪表盘审美做成 skill + check 闭环：6 套命名风格与 38 条规则，调整 ECharts 看板、检查结果，再修改。
zh.forAgents: 用 `npx skills add FelixFangX/dashtaste` 安装 `dashtaste-global` 或 `dashtaste-cn`。从 6 套命名风格中选择，运行 38 条规则检查（v0.0.8），根据带规则 ID、修复建议和 0–100 分的 JSON 结果继续修改。用 `--pack-file` 叠加本地规则，用 `docs/cases` 讲解画廊中的变化。

en.pitch: For when you have a vague research itch. You get ranked directions backed by real papers, plus a 7-day plan.
en.forAgents: An MCP server with `propose_directions` and `expand`, both read-only. Each citation carries its check result, so an agent can see which ones are real.

zh.pitch: 有个模模糊糊的研究念头时用。给你几条排好序、有真论文撑腰的方向，外加一份 7 天计划。
zh.forAgents: 一个 MCP 服务，提供 `propose_directions` 和 `expand` 两个只读工具。每条引用都带着核查结果，Agent 能看出哪些是真的。

en.pitch: Status lights for agents, plus a browser game where an AI builds a web page and you decide what ships.
en.forAgents: It learns permission rules from your own allow/deny history, turns a subagent into an A2A Agent Card, and runs as a GitHub Action. The game runs on the same engine, and every generated page is sandboxed and checked before you see it.

zh.pitch: 给 Agent 装的状态灯，外加一个浏览器小游戏：AI 现场写网页，上不上线你说了算。
zh.forAgents: 能从你自己的允许/拒绝记录里学出权限规则，能把 Claude Code 的子 Agent 转成 A2A Agent Card，也能当 GitHub Action 跑。游戏用的是同一套引擎，AI 生成的每个页面都先进沙箱检查一遍，才会给你看。

en.pitch: An Agent skill that turns a chat bot into a careful dev assistant. It drafts first and asks before anything leaves the room.
en.forAgents: v1.0.0 safety verification: 42/42 rule-string coverage in CI, 50/50 deterministic authority fixtures, and 12/20 on the model eval against `glm-4.7-flash` (relayed approvals, pasted tokens, and prompt injection in repo files and web pages).

zh.pitch: 一个 Agent skill，把聊天机器人调教成谨慎的开发助手：先出草稿，什么东西要发出去都先问你。
zh.forAgents: v1.0.0 安全验证：CI 中 42/42 规则文本覆盖、50/50 确定性权限夹具测试，以及 `glm-4.7-flash` 上 12/20 的模型评测（覆盖转述授权、贴入 token 及藏在仓库文件和网页里的提示注入）。

en.pitch: Import-ready n8n workflows, secrets scrubbed: Lark/Feishu bot → Bitable records and PRD drafts, and social metrics.
en.forAgents: Every workflow comes with a manifest: input and output schema, side effects, and the exact `execute_workflow` call for n8n's MCP server. They all say "ask first", because each one writes data or spends quota.

zh.pitch: 导入就能用的 n8n 工作流，敏感信息已清理：飞书/Lark 机器人消息转成多维表格记录和 PRD 草稿，外加社媒数据追踪。
zh.forAgents: 每个工作流都带一份 manifest：输入输出 schema、会产生什么副作用，以及调用 n8n MCP 服务时现成的 `execute_workflow` 参数。全部标了“先问人”，因为每个都会写数据或者花额度。

en.pitch: My GitHub profile, rebuilt every day from real runs and evals.
en.forAgents: It publishes `llms.txt` and `status.json`. Red means red, and missing data says "no data" instead of making something up.

zh.pitch: 我的 GitHub 主页，每天用真实的运行和评测结果重新生成。
zh.forAgents: 对外提供 `llms.txt` 和 `status.json`。红就是红，没数据就写“no data”，不编。
